subject: re-st
title: (R)RE.ST. ------ POL.DY.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-31 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two) accompanying Braxton's diagnostic on transformation: 'the route to transformation — positive transformation — will be as progressional as the developments which have produced this cycle, having to do with the gradual acquisition of information and composite functionalism as a means to move towards reinstatement.' (R)RE-ST (the reality of restructuralism) is crossed with POL-DY (political dynamics): the question is what restructuralism produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with political-dynamics — the (R) prefix marking that real restructuralism (not gradual restyling) is what produces real transformation. POL-DY sits at the upper-center. T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication) anchors the upper-right output. EXTN (extension) sits between subject and partner. DYM-SPT (dynamics-spectacle) and IST-P (interior-source principle) form the middle cluster. RIT-DY (ritual dynamics) feeds in from the lower-left. METH (methodology) sits centrally below. IF-ST-DY (information-style dynamics) anchors the lower-right output. EXT-FT (extended functionalism) hangs on the right margin. POST (postulation) anchors the bottom-center. Structural argument: restructuralism-as-real crossed with political-dynamics is mediated by extension as central hub, with ritual-dynamics and methodology as lower upstreams. The diagram exposes Braxton's structural diagnostic for real transformation: the route from restructuralism through political-dynamics produces temporal-continuity-implication only when methodology and ritual-dynamics function as live upstreams. The dynamics-spectacle and interior-source-principle pairing as middle cluster registers Braxton's structural tension — interior-source-principle is what allows real restructuralism to resist the spectacle-pull that political-dynamics tends to introduce.
